Its claim of no added processing is an uploader statement, not a separate audio comparison.

Rule 2 — United States recording published in 1920, before the programme cutoff Inferred, not documented

DAHR’s disc record supplies Victor [1920], separately from the 18 February recording date. Under 17 USC 1401, pre-1923 sound recordings entered the US public domain in 2022. The Archive Public Domain Mark is not itself treated as a licence.
